setlist.title: Stuck In Mobile With The Memphis Blues Again

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Ramble On Rose** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out Ramble On Rose, Help On The Way and He's Gone as excellent versions; Hornsby's grand piano shapes Ramble On Rose, and Jerry's MIDI trumpet solo is taken to another level [24][26]
- **High Time** (1 review): The first set pairs Let The Good Times Roll into Feel Like A Stranger, with rarely played They Love Each Other and High Time [26]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Estimated Prophet is well played, with Welnick adding horn-like keyboard sounds that lead into a standout He's Gone [16]
- **Jam** (1 review): Hornsby leads a chilling vocal jam that lifted the Omni to its rafters [16]
- **Memphis Blues** (1 review): Stuck Inside of Mobile with the Memphis Blues Again resonated personally with a Memphis fan who had driven to the show [21]

## Setlist highlights

- **Jam**: with The Other Ones Tease [28]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-04-04.fob.schoepsCMC34.unknown.GEMS.93472.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 172 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1991-04-04.akg.dodd.larson.patch-15548.24711.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 167 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording is first rate and powerful despite some glitches; reviewer says a soundboard isn't needed; Uploader copied left channel into right channel at listed times to remove heavy static, probably from a loose cord on the right mics [2][20]
- **gd91-04-04.akg.dodd.15548.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 163 min; rated 4.2/5 by 5 [3]. Said about its sound: Only an audience recording circulates here, unlike the neighboring nights, which have clean soundboards; the reviewer marks the show down for that; The audience-recording sound detracts from enjoyment, in contrast to the soundboards listeners have grown used to; Reviewer prefers hearing audience tapes; the soundboards from this tour sound so clean as to be sterile [16][17][19]
- **gd1991-04-04.sbd.miller.99240.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 167 min; rated 3.67/5 by 12 [6]
- **gd1991-04-04.152093.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 169 min [7]

## Around the show

- Guests: The Other Ones Tease [1]
- Reviewer describes the whole night as magical, with the band rocking Atlanta and a strong first set [18]
- Reviewer drove from Memphis for this third and last Atlanta night, and felt the Memphis Blues song was played for them [21]
- Reviewer drove from Knoxville, bought a ticket in the lot, and was turned away at the door as a bad ticket [23]
- Reviewer, who attended much of the spring tour, calls it the highlight of the Atlanta '91 run and a top-ten show [18]
- Reviewer saw the preceding Greensboro shows but missed the Omni; notes few of the new tunes in this show [24]
- Reviewer finds the second set the stronger half, though the first set is also fun [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-04-04.fob.schoepsCMC34.unknown.GEMS.93472.flac16**: transferred by Todd Evans, Jamie Waddell; source: (FOB) Schoeps CMC34 (ORTF) -> Panasonic sv255 [1]
- **gd1991-04-04.akg.dodd.larson.patch-15548.24711.shnf**: taped by Thomas Larson; transferred by Ernie Dodd; source: FOB> AKGc1000s>Sony Cassette D3 > cdr [2]
- **gd91-04-04.akg.dodd.15548.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB> AKGc1000s>Sony Cassette D3 > cdrEac > cool edit > shntool > cdwav >shnv3Taped by Thomas LarsonDiscs provided by Chris AdamsEac >shn (secure with proper… [3]
- **gd1991-04-04.sbd.miller.99240.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Sony D5/TDK SA90) [6]. Also: Soundboard has Memphis Blues beginning patched from a Schoeps CMC3/MK4 audience tape via DAT and CD, with pitch correction [6]
- **gd1991-04-04.152093.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  March 8, 2021; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [7]. Also: Soundboard recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy, with a patch source for Memphis Blues, converted from 24-bit to 16-bit [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1991-04-03 The Omni, Atlanta, GA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1991-04-03-the-omni-atlanta-ga-usa/) [29]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1991-04-04 The Omni, Atlanta, GA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1991-04-04-the-omni-atlanta-ga-usa/) [30]
